title: JSON API Input Validation Review
summary: The endpoint accepts JSON input, so schema validation, mass assignment, and injection-safe parsing should be reviewed.
operator_questions: Can you add extra JSON fields or type-confused values without server-side rejection?
Does changing numeric or identifier fields affect objects owned by other users?

title: CORS Policy Review
summary: The response exposes CORS headers that may need validation for wildcard or reflected-origin behavior.
operator_questions: Does the server reflect arbitrary Origin headers or allow credentials with broad origins?

title: Reflected CORS Origin Review
summary: The response appears to reflect the request Origin or use wildcard CORS, which can weaken browser-enforced access restrictions.
operator_questions: Are cookies or Authorization tokens accepted on cross-origin requests to this endpoint?

title: Mobile/API Auth Context Review
summary: The request carries bearer-style authorization and should be checked for role scoping, token audience, and object-level authorization.
operator_questions: Does the same token access data for other users, devices, or tenants when identifier fields are changed?

title: File Upload Handling Review
summary: The request indicates multipart upload behavior and should be checked for content-type trust, extension filtering, and storage exposure.
operator_questions: Can you alter filename, content type, or double extensions without server-side rejection?
Are uploaded files served back from a web-accessible path or another origin?

title: Redirect Parameter Review
summary: Redirect-like parameter names suggest checking whether the application allows off-domain navigation or token leakage via open redirect behavior.
operator_questions: Can redirect or return-style parameters send the browser to an external domain after auth or workflow completion?
Do any OAuth or SSO flows trust these redirect values without strict allowlisting?

title: Server-Side URL Fetch Review
summary: URL-like input parameters suggest checking whether the server fetches external or internal resources on behalf of the client.
operator_questions: Does changing URL-like parameters make the server fetch internal hosts, localhost, or cloud metadata endpoints?
Are protocols, ports, redirects, or DNS rebinding behaviors filtered server-side?

title: XML / XXE Review
summary: XML input should be reviewed for unsafe parser behavior, external entities, and SSRF-style resolution paths.
operator_questions: Does the endpoint parse XML with DTD or external entity support enabled?
Can XML input influence outbound requests, local file reads, or parser errors?

title: Reflected Input Review
summary: Search-like or user-controlled input parameters in an HTML response should be reviewed for reflection, context, and output encoding.
operator_questions: Are any query or form parameters reflected in the HTML response, script context, attributes, or inline JSON?
Does the response encode or sanitize user-controlled input consistently across contexts?
